climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Seasons this mild ripen Pinot Gris, Gewürztraminer, Riesling, Pinot Noir and Chardonnay fully without cooking off their freshness.
Gewürztraminer, Riesling, Pinot Gris and Pinot Noir sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

soil.rock: Sandstone is sand bound into rock. It weathers to light, sandy soil that drains freely. Granite weathers to coarse, acid, free-draining soil that warms quickly and holds heat. Its acidity tends to lower the grapes' acidity, which suits Gamay.
soil.top: The topsoil holds water well and drains at a steady pace, so vines rarely go thirsty or sit in wet ground. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Gentle slopes. Enough tilt to drain cold air and rain away, which lowers frost risk, yet still easy to farm by machine.
Faces the morning sun. Early light dries the dew, which cuts disease, and the grapes are spared the hottest afternoon sun.
